simple.meaning: דֶּמַע (demaʻ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a tear ; figuratively, juice.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H1831. dema [ דֶּ֫מַע ] noun [masculine] (weeping, trickling) juice , i.e. wine or (&) oil (compare following) דִּמְעֲךָ Exod 22:28 (|| מְלֵאָֽתְךָ ), compare Di; Arabic = wine.
